newsitem.title: USA: Amoco to recomplete Opon-6 well in Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Amoco to recomplete Opon-6 well in Colombia.

text.p: Hondo Oil & Gas Co said Thursday the Opon No. 6 well is being prepared for a new completion and testing.

Updating its March 26 announcement that testing of the Opon No. 6 well would be delayed for reasons related to the mechanical completion of the well, Hondo said an investigation of the completion results has revealed that about half of the perforating guns did not fire.
Therefore, a significant portion of the La Paz formation was never opened for testing.
Hondo owns an interest in the well located at the Opon Contract area in the Middle Magdalena Valley of Colombia which is operated by Amoco Corp.
